head: Google Fi app redesign on Android adds Ask Fi AI support button
dek: Google Fi's Android app has moved its tabs into a floating bar and added an Ask Fi button that opens Google's AI support chat. It's rolling out with app version 171.
details: The five tabs stay the same: Home, Plan, Billing, Shop and Support. Ask Fi gives account help and troubleshooting, and if you ask for a person, your chat goes along so you don't have to repeat yourself. The new look is switched on from Google's side, so it may not show right after you update. Wi-Fi Auto Connect+, so far only on Pixel phones, is coming to select Samsung and Motorola phones.
where: Google Fi app for Android, version 171, rolling out from Google's side
means: If you're on Google Fi, questions about your bill or plan can start in the app's AI chat, and a person can pick up the same conversation if you need one.
todo: Update the Google Fi app from Google Play; if the new look isn't there yet, check again in a few days.
thumb_words: GOOGLE FI APP ADDS ASK FI AI HELP
